label: Trust & Security
title: Trust and Security
intro: Independent audits, documented controls, and the reports your security and legal teams will ask for. Start with the JustCall Trust Center.

sections.title: Six frameworks, independently assessed
sections.label: Certifications
intro: Each one has its own report, and its own request link. Certifications listed here apply to JustCall. ServiceAgent and PyAI are listed by product below.

blocks.title: SOC 2 Type 2
body: Independent audit of security, availability, and confidentiality controls over a full observation period.

blocks.title: ISO/IEC 27001 2022
body: Certified information security management system, covering how risk is assessed, treated, and reviewed.

blocks.title: PCI DSS v4.0.0
body: Payment card data handled to the current PCI standard, including redaction during calls and transcripts.

blocks.title: HIPAA Health data
body: Safeguards for protected health information, with a Business Associate Agreement available for covered entities.

blocks.title: GDPR EU privacy
body: Data-processing responsibilities, transfer safeguards, and data-subject rights, documented for EU customers.

blocks.title: CSA STAR Level 1
body: Cloud Security Alliance self-assessment, published against the Cloud Controls Matrix.

sections.title: The questions security reviews ask
intro: Short answers here. The full detail is in the documents above.

blocks.title: How is data encrypted?
body: TLS for data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest, across JustCall. Key management details are in the SOC 2 report.

blocks.title: How are backups handled?
body: Regular backups with established data-handling and restore procedures.

blocks.title: Do you run penetration tests?
body: Yes, by an independent third party, alongside continuous vulnerability management. Summaries are available on request under NDA.

blocks.title: Where is my data stored, and can I choose a region?
body: Infrastructure runs on AWS and Google Cloud.

blocks.title: Who are your subprocessors?
body: The current list, and how changes are notified, is published in the JustCall Trust Center.

blocks.title: Will you sign a DPA or a BAA?
body: Yes. A Data Processing Agreement is available to every customer, and a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement to covered entities. Use the request links under Documentation.

blocks.title: How quickly are customers told about a security incident?
body: Incident response is documented in the operational policies, and availability incidents are published on the status page.

blocks.title: Is there a bug bounty or disclosure program?
body: Vulnerability reports are accepted through the security and compliance page.

closing.title: Have a security question?
body: Send it to the security team, or report a vulnerability through the security and compliance page.
